phiusiil_url_artefacts.finding: Every legitimate PhiUSIIL URL is a bare https://www.<domain> homepage. URL models trained on raw PhiUSIIL learn this artefact; we canonicalise URLs and add a second source of legitimate deep links.

sources.name: uci_phishing_websites
sources.description: UCI Phishing Websites (Mohammad, Thabtah & McCluskey, 2012) - 11,055 rows x 30 ternary features

sources.name: phiusiil
sources.description: PhiUSIIL Phishing URL Dataset (Prasad & Chandra, 2024) - 235,795 URLs with URL + HTML features

sources.description: 420k labelled URLs with full paths (faizann24, 2016) - adds legitimate deep links that PhiUSIIL lacks
